title: be: Negatives and Short Answers
objective: Say what is not true with I'm not / isn't / aren't, and answer questions with Yes, I am / No, I'm not.
intro_md: [L1: In this lesson you say what is NOT true — I'm not a teacher — and give short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Careful: short answers end in the full form. Say Yes, I am — never Yes, I'm.]
notes: TODO_audio: ex2 (I'm not a teacher. I'm a student., 0.75x), ex6 (Are you a student?, 1.0x), ex9 speaking model prompt. Band map §15 allots L08 no new vocabulary (grammar G5 only): all negative and short-answer forms are function words; this file honestly teaches 0 items and recycles L04-L07 content words.

exercises.prompt: I'm not… · isn't · aren't · Yes, I am. · No, I'm not.
exercises.rationale: Presents the negative and short-answer frames as chunks with audio before rule work; these five frames are the entire target of the lesson.

exercises.prompt: [audio, 0.75x] 'I'm not a teacher. I'm a student.' — [L1: What is the speaker?]
exercises.rationale: not is short and unstressed; learners who miss it understand the opposite of what was said — the highest-cost listening error this lesson prevents.

options.label: A student.
options.rationale: not negates teacher; the second sentence states the fact.

options.label: A teacher.
options.rationale: Hears the noun but misses not — the exact miscomprehension this exercise trains against.

options.label: A new student.
options.rationale: Adds information that was never said; catches guessing from known words instead of listening.

exercises.prompt: I ___ not from Brazil. I'm from Mexico.
exercises.rationale: not attaches after the conjugated be-form; agreement (am with I) must survive under negation, where load makes learners regress.
not placement directly after the contraction; predicted ar/zh error is dropping be entirely ('I not teacher') — the token set makes I'm indivisible so the copula cannot be lost.

exercises.prompt: [L1: Match each question to its short answer.]
exercises.rationale: Short answers echo the be-form of the question and nothing else; matching across persons (you→I, she→she) blocks the bare 'Yes.' answer transfer from es/zh.

exercises.prompt: [audio, 1.0x] 'Are you a student?' — [L1: Choose the correct short answer.]
exercises.rationale: Targets the single most common short-answer error at this level: ending the answer with the contraction (Yes, I'm).

options.label: Yes, I am.
options.rationale: Affirmative short answers use the full, stressed form am — a sentence cannot end in I'm.

options.label: Yes, I'm.
options.rationale: The classic error: contractions are never sentence-final in English — this is the trap the lesson exists to defuse.

options.label: Yes, I are.
options.rationale: Agreement error under question pressure: are is copied from the question instead of switching to am.

exercises.prompt: A: Are you from Vietnam?  B: No, I'm ___. I'm from Haiti.
exercises.rationale: es 'no soy' maps two Spanish words onto English no + not: 'no' in the bank catches direct transfer, 'don't' catches do-negation overgeneralized to be.

exercises.prompt: [L1: Say it in English: 'No soy profesora. Soy estudiante.']
exercises.key: I'm not a teacher. I'm a student.
exercises.rationale: Bundles the three es-to-en changes in one item: supply the pronoun, use not (not 'no'), and add the article a before the role noun.

exercises.prompt: [audio] 'Are you a teacher?' → [L1: Answer truthfully with a short answer, then say what you are.]
asr_focus: released final t in not (vi/zh final-consonant deletion)
full am if the answer is Yes, I am
exercises.rationale: Produces the short-answer-plus-correction move learners need constantly in real intake conversations; ASR checks the audible not.

exercises.prompt: [L1: The AI has wrong ideas about you — your name, your country, what you are. Listen, correct each one with a negative, then say what is true.]
exercises.rationale: The band-file communicative need for G5 verbatim — correct wrong information about you; recycles L03/L05 chunks under real-time pressure; guided-interaction minutes.
